keyword: what time is the selection show
claims: The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show is Sunday, March 15, at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT) on CBS and Paramount+.
The Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special follows at 8 p.m. ET (5 p.m. PT) on ESPN.
Both the 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show and the Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special reveal the 68-team fields for March Madness.
The Women’s Selection Show is at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN/ESPN App.

Live streams of the 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show and the Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special are available via Paramount+, ESPN App, March Madness Live, and services like Fubo or YouTube TV.
The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show and the Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special will reveal the brackets.
The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show and the Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special will reveal the seedings.
The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Selection Show and the Women’s NCAA Tournament Selection Special will reveal the first-round matchups.
